work.summary: Energy and Security Outreach Office. Supported quick-build street safety work and shoreline resilience research.
highlights: Contributed to a Quick Build Guidebook for HDOT, drafting report sections and policy-comparison content aimed at both engineers and the public.
Built a web-based scoring matrix tool concept using HTML and JavaScript that ranks quick-build projects by weighted factors like crash history, cost, and school proximity.
Researched methods to recreate nearshore beach conditions in aquarium setups, supporting ongoing study of the Kalaeloa hybrid reef built to reduce wave energy and protect Oahu shorelines.

work.summary: Prepared and cooked made-to-order katsu with an emphasis on quality and presentation.
highlights: Prepared and cooked various katsu made-to-order using deep-fryers, pulling each at the correct temperature and plating with clean presentation.
Maintained a clean workstation and followed safety guidelines to prevent hazards and food contamination.
Kept a safe work environment and smooth flow of service through clear communication.

work.summary: Cooked high-volume made-to-order food in a fast-paced kitchen.

Followed safety procedures by maintaining a clean workstation, storing ingredients in correct areas, and cooking food to safe temperatures.
Communicated with team members to keep the flow of service running smoothly.
